weather.name: nasa_power_embassy_daily_2016_2021.csv
weather.interpretation: Calendar labels overlap; weather days areUTC while exact embassy averaging interval is unverified. No paired weather effects estimated here.

weather.association_alignment: weather_date = EPA nominal date + shift - lag; shifts -1/0/+1 all reported
weather.association_adjustment: descriptive residual correlations after calendar-month or year+calendar-month fixed effects; fit on inspected pairs, not predictive preprocessing
weather.prediction_alignment: nominal shift0; lag2weather PRIMARY conservative for UTC/BST daily intervals; lag1weather overlapping-day conditional benchmark only
weather.timing_evidence: Parent mirror cross-check supports BST-labelled EPA means in2019-Jun2020; full-record convention remains incompletely verified. NASA lag1 UTC daily interval ends06BST on targetday, after00BST nominal issue; lag2 ends06BST precedingday.
weather.weather_choice: retain T2M,RH2M,WS10M,PRECTOTCORR,PS; omit thermodynamically redundant dewpoint from ridge, show VIF for both sets
weather.refit: expanding monthly; each training fold strictly before refit month; daily observed lag updates
weather.uncertainty: paired calendar moving blocks 7 and30days, seed20261107, percentile95%; no model selection
limitations: EPA BST alignment supported by independent mirror in part of record; full-record timezone/QA not established. NASA dates UTC.
NASA POWER/MERRA2 meteorology is model-derived, not original ERA5.
Observed-data provenance does not establish independent reference-grade QA or exact daily completeness.
Actual source publication latency unverified; results are conditional hindcasts, not operational forecasts.
Lag screen exploratory and multiple comparisons uncorrected; no causal effect or optimal lag claim.
The bootstrap is descriptive conditional uncertainty for these fitted forecasts; no causal interpretation.

presentation: Primary weather branch only in model table/figure; lag-one conditional sensitivity remains in full run.

station_day.purpose: Station-day identity/alignment sensitivity within the embassy monitoring network, not independent-site validation

mirror_QC.interpretation: Four averaging-label hypotheses for the same monitoring series; not four independent stations or independent source validations.

station_day.bias_definition: Mirror daily mean minus EPA-hosted daily mean
